messages:
Claire: Follow-up from the postmortem — we need owners for the remaining rollout safety items: staged rollback simulation, synthetic canary traffic, and blast-radius quota. Short owner + ETA please.

Jon: I'll own staged-rollback simulation (simulate rollback without changing prod) — ETA: 2026-04-05 for prototype and 2026-04-12 for canary-run. Blocker: need a safe read-only hook into the rollout controller.

Ravi: I'll take synthetic canary traffic generator and the sample-size logic. ETA: 2026-03-29 for generator MVP and 2026-04-08 to wire it into the pipeline.

deploy-bot: Suggested low-traffic window: 2026-04-11 01:00-03:00 UTC. Please add `pre-deploy-check` label.

Claire: For tracking: create JIRA tickets and add acceptance criteria (what "done" means). Jon -> PMR-9101, Ravi -> PMR-9102.

Jon: Staged-rollback prototype sketch: dry-run mode logs the rollback decision and runs the rollback path in simulation. Output includes selected variant + reason + simulated traffic delta. Example output: `SIM_ROLLBACK route=/generate variant=stable->v2 reason=latency_spike`. Will emit `rollback.simulation` events.

Ravi: Synthetic generator notes: support weighted user profiles, regional shaping, and a fast-zipf load for tail behavior. Will include `min_sample` gating and a flag to spoof headers for routing.

SRE: Ops asks: simulation events must be clearly labeled and never trigger automated actions. Also require a way to promote a simulation to a dry-canary (controlled traffic cutover). Index simulation events separately from real rollbacks.

Lena: I'll own blast-radius quota enforcement in flags UI/API. Deliverable: schema + UI mock by 2026-03-27, API PR by 2026-04-04. Plan to support quotas like `quota: { users: 500, requests_per_min: 10000 }` to limit impact.

Infra QA: We'll add an automated end-to-end test that runs a simulated rollback and ensures no stateful DB changes. ETA: 2026-04-06 for test harness.

Claire: Acceptance criteria recap: PMR-9101 (Jon) emits `rollback.simulation` for each staged run, includes chosen variant, reason, and metric snapshot. PMR-9102 (Ravi) provides generator + min_sample gating. PMR-9103 (Lena) enforces quota caps and region scoping. Add smoke tests and run first 3 dry-canaries with SRE.

Jon: Created PMR-9101: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PMR-9101 and opened draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/3333 (WIP).

Ravi: Created PMR-9102 and posted generator design doc: https://docs.redwood.com/synthetic-canary (WIP).

Lena: Created PMR-9103 and uploaded UI mock.

SRE: Reminder: ensure rollback events (real ones) include route, variant_from, variant_to, reason, metrics_snapshot, sample_size and are retained 90d. Simulation events must be separate and marked `simulated=true`.

Claire: Please paste PR and ticket links when updated. I'll move these to "in progress" on the postmortem board and check at next ops sync (2026-04-13). If anyone slips beyond ETA, update the ticket and ping me. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Reminder: add `deployment-checklist` label to PRs touching rollout/rollback logic.

Infra QA: Quick test run commands to include in runbook:
```bash
# run simulated rollback against staging
curl -X POST https://internal-api/rollouts/simulate -d '{"route":"/generate","variant":"v2"}'
# verify no variant switch occurred
curl https://internal-api/rollouts/status?route=/generate | jq .current_variant
```

Claire: Closing thread for tracking. Will escalate to leads if dates slip.
